portal_description:
The NetworkManager-libreswan package contains software for integrating the libreswan VPN software with NetworkManager and the GNOME desktop.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Add Custom DPD Parameter Support to NetworkManager's IPSec Configuration and Custom naming scheme for IPSec in NM-libreswan (JIRA:RHEL-19224)
